name: United States: IRS guidance (Internal Revenue Bulletin)
label: United States (IRS guidance)
record_note: Each item as first published in the Internal Revenue Bulletin, bulletins 1996-01 to 2026-46: 1,306 × Treasury decision (final or temporary regulations), 2,074 announcements, 2,467 notices, 1,114 × notice of proposed rulemaking (proposed regulations), 1,697 revenue procedures, 1,453 revenue rulings. Later items that modify or supersede an item are their own commits (Effect: trailers); the earlier file is not rewritten. Dated by the item's own effective-date sentence where it has one, else by its bulletin.
